name: Starfish Island
lore: Where Leonida's elite retreat. Ultra-modern compounds hide the city's darkest secrets.
fullDescription: Starfish Island is an exclusive gated community in the heart of Vice City's waterways. Home to drug lords, corrupt politicians, and tech billionaires, every mansion here has a story — and most of them end badly. The island's pristine exterior masks a web of underground tunnels, private docks for midnight deliveries, and security systems that rival military installations.

name: Downtown Vice City
lore: The beating heart of Leonida. Neon-soaked streets, towering corporate headquarters, and deals made in shadow.
fullDescription: Downtown is where power lives in Vice City. Glass towers pierce the humid sky, housing the offices of corporations that run everything from media to money laundering. By day, it's suits and briefcases. By night, the streets transform into a neon-lit playground where anything goes. The VCN Tower dominates the skyline, broadcasting carefully curated news to keep the masses distracted.

name: Ocean Beach
lore: Where tropical beauty meets urban soul. A place where dreams are made... and sometimes broken.
fullDescription: Ocean Beach is Vice City's postcard. Art deco hotels line the waterfront, bodybuilders pump iron on the sand, and street vendors sell everything from fresh juice to fake IDs. But look past the pastel facades and you'll find a community fighting gentrification, underground fight clubs, and a surf culture that runs deeper than the ocean itself.

name: The Malls
lore: Where consumption is culture and luxury is law.
fullDescription: The Malls district is Vice City's monument to excess. Three interconnected mega-malls house designer boutiques, electronics superstores, and food courts that serve cuisine from every corner of the globe. Beneath the fluorescent lights, shoplifting rings operate with military precision, and the parking garages have witnessed more deals than the stock exchange.

name: Prawn Island
lore: Where Vice City's underbelly operates. Industrial, unforgiving, and absolutely essential.
fullDescription: Prawn Island was once the heart of Vice City's film industry. Now the abandoned studios serve as warehouses, chop shops, and meeting points for the city's most dangerous operators. The rusting infrastructure creates a maze that even police helicopters struggle to navigate, making it the perfect hideout for those who need to disappear.

name: Vice Point
lore: Where Leonida's new money builds its empire. Modern, ambitious, unapologetically expensive.
fullDescription: Vice Point is the new frontier of Vice City wealth. Luxury condominiums with infinity pools overlook the Atlantic, while the North Point Mall serves as a temple to consumerism. Tech startups, crypto bros, and influencers have colonized the district, creating a bubble of wealth that locals view with equal parts envy and contempt.

name: Viceport Harbor
lore: Industrial gateway. Cargo ships, cranes, and mysteries hidden in shipping containers.
fullDescription: Viceport is where Vice City's legitimate commerce meets its shadow economy. Container ships from South America dock alongside fishing boats, and the cargo that passes through these docks ranges from electronics to things that never appear on any manifest. The harbor workers have a code of silence that makes the mafia look chatty.

name: Washington Beach
lore: Late-night party district vibe. Where tourists become legends (or victims).
fullDescription: Washington Beach is where Vice City never sleeps. The strip is lined with clubs, bars, and late-night diners that cater to everyone from spring breakers to hardened criminals looking to unwind. The police presence is heavy but largely performative — everyone knows the real law here is the bouncer at Club Malibu.

name: Little Havana
lore: The soul of Vice City. Where culture, tradition, and resilience pulse through every street.
fullDescription: Little Havana is the cultural heartbeat of Vice City. Cuban coffee shops, domino tables on every corner, and murals that tell the story of generations who built this neighborhood from nothing. The community is tight-knit and fiercely protective of its identity, even as developers circle like sharks smelling blood in the water.

name: Escobar International Airport
lore: Where dreams arrive and destinies depart. The gateway to Leonida.
fullDescription: Escobar International is more than an airport — it's a crossroads of ambition. Private jets carrying cartel money share runways with commercial flights full of tourists who have no idea what they're walking into. The cargo terminals process shipments 24/7, and customs agents here have perfected the art of looking the other way.

name: Leaf Links Golf Course
lore: Where Leonida's elite conduct their most exclusive (and secretive) deals.
fullDescription: Leaf Links is where the real decisions about Vice City get made. Between holes 7 and 12, more mergers, acquisitions, and hostile takeovers have been negotiated than in any boardroom. Membership costs more than most houses, and the waiting list is longer than the fairways. The club's private rooms have hosted everyone from senators to cartel bosses.

name: Rockstar Island
lore: Leonida's most exclusive address. What happens here stays here. Access denied.
fullDescription: Rockstar Island is the forbidden zone of Vice City. No bridge, no ferry schedule — access is by private invitation only. The island hosts a compound that serves as equal parts private resort, recording studio, and fortress. Rumors range from underground fight tournaments to secret government facilities, but nobody who visits ever talks about what they saw.
